name: latex-agentic
description: Agents, skills, hooks and an Overleaf MCP server for XeLaTeX document development.

overleaf_base_url.title: Overleaf base URL
overleaf_base_url.description: Base URL of the Overleaf instance. Defaults to https://www.overleaf.com; set this to point at a self-hosted Community or Server Pro instance.

overleaf_git_token.title: Overleaf Git token
overleaf_git_token.description: Git authentication token from Overleaf Account Settings -> Git Integration (requires Overleaf premium or a self-hosted instance).

overleaf_session_cookie.title: Overleaf session cookie
overleaf_session_cookie.description: Value of the overleaf_session2 browser cookie. Enables the web transport for listing, creating, deleting and compiling projects.
